::: {#exm-universal-approximation}

#### Universal approximation for one input

For one input, the [ReLU](#def-relu) and a closed interval $[a, b]$,
@sol-any-curve builds the network that @thm-universal-approximation promises:
it joins points on the graph of $f$ with straight pieces,
and gives the network one [unit](#def-unit) for each piece.
Making the pieces shorter brings the network closer to $f$,
at the cost of more [unit](#def-unit)s.

:::
